richiami.difetto: It has been established that a manufacturing defect in the rotor of the fuel pump installed in the aforementioned machines can cause failure of the pump. This may cause the engine not start or it can cause the engine to stall if the machine is being used in particularly high ambient temperatures.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected machines to check and if require place the fuel pump.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on subject machines cracking of both main frame members can occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will be fitted with a steel support in the subject area.
